name: briefing_locator_panel_update
description: HudUiBriefingLocatorPanel::Update returns while hidden and, while visible, recomputes the locator dirty rect, shrinks and clamps its radius, updates the base element, and invalidates the panel.
known_limits: 0x403cb0 is byte-clean in the current Briefing.cpp source-file block target, but this functional target remains behavior evidence only.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x403cb0 validates the hidden early-return gate, GetX/GetY call shape, clip rect writes using the current radius, shrink by max(int(deltaSec * 20.0), 1), clamp to radius 3 with radiusSquared 9, direct HudUiElement::Update(deltaSec), and invalidation. Slot offsets are ABI evidence only.

The native smoke calls the recovered locator update path from a constructed briefing runtime and verifies hidden early return, visible clip rect recomputation, normal shrink, minimum shrink step, radius clamp, base update dirty-flag clearing, and final invalidate side effect; table-slot invocation assertions are stale after the source-model cleanup.
